name: sqlrename
description: Rename sql objects based on csv mapping

sqlrename.pythonPath.description: Python 3 executable. Use 'python3' (macOS/Linux), 'python' (Windows), or an absolute path.

sqlrename.mappingCsvPath.description: Path to the name mapping CSV. Leave empty to use the bundled CSV. A relative path (e.g. 'mappings/name_conversion.csv') is resolved from the workspace root. An absolute path is used as-is.

sqlrename.dbDialect.description: SQL dialect used by the source database (e.g. 'oracle', 'mysql', 'postgres', 'databricks'). Used when parsing SQL with sqlglot. Full set of options is here: https://sqlglot.com/sqlglot/dialects.html

sqlrename.targetSchema.description: Target schema name for rewritten table names. Leave empty to use the default schema.
